- An Android app. Pick a release and apps on the phone, build a signed
  recovery zip there, and save or share it. Same picker, presets and
  dependency handling as the desktop, and the zip it makes matches what the
  desktop builds for the same selection, file for file
- Builds on Android keep going in the background, with progress and a cancel
  button in the notification
- The file name can be changed before building
- Fixed: zips built with the Windows version would not flash ("Can't run
  /tmp/update-binary"). The installer scripts were packed with Windows line
  endings. Rebuild any zip made on Windows with 0.1.0 or 0.2.0
